$comment: Reference questions for `bun run eval`. Values come from data/lol.sqlite (schema v5, full scope, in-game stats from the Riot JSON on Leaguepedia as of 2026-11-14); key totals were cross-checked with independent SQL on the base tables. `expect` fields: route (tool name, sql or out_of_scope), players / teams / champion (resolved names, order matters), league (Leaguepedia League), input (subset of the tool input), rows (exact count) or rowsMin (minimum), totals (subset of answer.meta.totals), ambiguity ({mention, chosen, alternatives (subset)}), attempts, notes (substrings), sources (minimum count, Leaguepedia links). Timeline questions read the Riot JSON from R2 (R2_READ_*) or, locally, from data/raw/riot; without either their totals.timeline is "unconfigured". Checks that need a query result are skipped when the route is sql and no OPENROUTER_API_KEY is set. `now` is the date relative seasons are resolved against ("l'an dernier" = 2025). `expect.unread` lists the words the rules did not understand when they put the route in doubt (answer.meta.unread). A case marked `llm: true` needs the LLM to reach its expected route (the rules hand it to the LLM router): without a key only its rules-level checks run (steps, players, teams, champion, unread) and it is reported as needing the LLM, not as passed. The `paraphrase` cases are the 30 questions of the routing audit of 2026-11-14, the `variant` cases their variants. The `champion` and `lane` cases (2026-11-14) cover the champion profile and ranking tools and the role leaderboards; their key totals were cross-checked with independent SQL on the base tables. The `roster` cases (2026-11-14) cover the team roster tool (players by role over a period, renamed teams merged); their game counts were cross-checked with independent SQL on the base tables.
